subject: Emerson Street Left-Turn Restriction
overview: The Medford Traffic Commission met to consider traffic safety measures, parking space relocations, and residential parking petitions. Key actions included approving an emergency left-turn restriction from Emerson Street onto Main Street and establishing new resident permit parking restrictions.

items.title: Petition 2023-49: Handicapped Parking - 147 George Street
items.summary: Approved a petition for a designated handicapped parking space at 147 George Street.

items.title: Petition 2023-47: No Left Turn from Emerson Street to Main Street
items.summary: Approved the Chief of Police's emergency measure prohibiting left turns from Emerson Street onto Main Street to address a high frequency of crashes, with plans to monitor the site and revisit the decision in three months.

items.title: Petition 2023-50: Yale Street Lot Handicapped Space Relocation
items.summary: Approved relocating two handicapped parking spaces in the Yale Street public lot to improve direct sidewalk accessibility and align with ADA standards.

items.title: Petition 2023-51: High Street and Hillside Avenue Parking Delineation
items.summary: Referred sight-line and parking space marking concerns at High Street and Hillside Avenue to traffic engineering for evaluation.

items.title: Petition 2023-52: Parking Restrictions on Willis Avenue
items.summary: Approved establishing a no-parking tow zone on the east side of Willis Avenue between Congress Avenue and Alexander Avenue, while remanding the street to traffic engineering for a broader traffic calming study.

items.title: Petition 2023-53: Parking Variance for 164 Harvard Street
items.summary: Approved a resident parking variance allowing an applicant from 164 Harvard Street to park on Wareham Street.

items.title: Petition 2023-56: Resident Permit Parking on Harvard Avenue
items.summary: Approved establishing resident permit parking on Harvard Avenue between Bower Avenue and Boston Avenue.

items.title: Petition 2023-54: Mystic Avenue Parking Spaces near VFW
items.summary: Approved adding approximately seven parking spaces along Mystic Avenue in front of the VFW building.

items.title: Petition 2023-55: City Hall Lot Commuter Permit Parking
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to introduce resident commuter permit parking in the City Hall parking lot until the December meeting.
